title: Gemeente Amsterdam — Ondergrond (WMS)
note: One of the MapServer maps behind the city's map viewer (data.amsterdam.nl/data/geozoek), read from the viewer's own layer configuration. MapServer publishes one mapfile per theme and no list of them, so each is its own source. Excluded, as of 2026-11-16: rioolleidingen_verb_gemengd hold no features.
